title: When Does Scale-Invariant Optimization Become Unstable? An Exact Schedule Law with Weight Decay
abstract: arXiv:2609.09116v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Normalization renders large parts of neural networks effectively scale invariant, inducing a hidden feedback loop in which learning-rate schedules and weight decay interact through the parameter norm to control the effective step taken by the optimizer. We show that this interaction is governed by an exact discrete-time law: a single scalar quantity captures all schedule and decay forcing, while norm growth induces an opposing geometric self-quenching effect. This yields a sharp boundary that cleanly separates contraction- and expansion-dominated effective learning rate regimes. translated_title: 尺度不变优化何时变得不稳定？带权重衰减的精确调度定律
translated_abstract: 归一化使得神经网络的大部分部分在实际上具有尺度不变性，从而诱导出一个隐藏的反馈回路：学习率调度与权重衰减通过参数范数相互作用，共同控制优化器所采取的有效步长。我们证明这种相互作用由一个精确的离散时间定律所支配：一个单一的标量量捕捉了所有调度和衰减的驱动力，而范数增长则产生一种相反的几何自猝灭效应。这得出了一个清晰的边界，明确地区分了以收缩为主导和以扩张为主导的有效学习率区域。为了理解其底层机制，我们对一个完全求解的归一化回归模型进行了精确分析，该模型的动力学可简化为二维，并证明其平衡点本质上是不可稳定的，这意味着恒定学习率结合权重衰减无法稳定地维持内部平衡，而是会产生由（后文截断）驱动的循环行为。
tldr: 该论文推导出一个精确的离散时间定律，揭示归一化导致的尺度不变性使学习率调度与权重衰减通过参数范数相互作用来控制有效步长，并证明该平衡点本质不稳定，因此恒定学习率加权重衰减无法稳定收敛，而是产生循环行为。
en_tdlr: This paper derives an exact discrete-time law showing that learning-rate schedules and weight decay interact through the parameter norm to control the effective step size in scale-invariant optimization, and proves the balance point is intrinsically unstable, so a constant learning rate with weight decay produces recurrent behavior instead of stable convergence.
